description: A repeat of a create whose key is revoked since is the 409 key_not_replayable: its secret is never shown again. The base error, raised, not retried.

headers.x-decisionnode-error: The key this Idempotency-Key made is revoked or its secret can no longer be shown: revoke it if it is not, then create a new key with a new Idempotency-Key.
